guidance.summary: Starting Bilaspur plant will add capacity of 72,000 bottles per day
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Kumar Jain
guidance.quote: First of all our Bilaspur plant which is not working at the moment because of some reasons of state government, so now the issue is resolved and we will be very soon starting the Bilaspur plant. So, that will add capacity of 72,000 bottles per day.
